Congress Marks Anniversary of Bharat Jodo Yatra

The Congress party marked the four-year anniversary of its Bharat Jodo Yatra, describing the event as a significant turning point in Indian politics. Party leaders stated the Yatra's purpose was to listen to public concerns rather than to preach. The initiative, led by Rahul Gandhi, aimed to connect with the 'Janta ki Chinta' (people's worries) as opposed to a one-way communication like 'Mann ki Baat' (a radio address).
